details: Bitcoin reclaimed the $82,000 mark, continuing its recovery. This uptrend is largely attributed to a weakening US dollar and comments from Secretary of State Marco Rubio, signaling a de-escalation in the Iran conflict. This geopolitical development has also led to lower oil prices and increased the likelihood of Federal Reserve interest rate cuts, providing a direct tailwind for Bitcoin and the broader crypto market.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $82K Amid Dollar Weakness and Geopolitical De-escalation

details: The White House is reportedly aiming for a July 4 deadline to pass a significant crypto regulation bill. This legislative push could introduce considerable changes to the US crypto landscape, potentially offering more regulatory clarity and fostering broader adoption.
title: White House Targets July 4 for Landmark Crypto Regulation Bill

details: Solana and Google Cloud are collaborating to facilitate stablecoin-powered payments for AI agents. This partnership aims to enhance the utility of stablecoins and integrate blockchain technology further into artificial intelligence applications, potentially boosting Solana's adoption and expanding the use cases for digital assets.
title: Solana and Google Cloud Partner for Stablecoin-Powered AI Agent Payments

details: Circle, the issuer of the USDC stablecoin, saw its shares increase by 20% following reports that US lawmakers have reached an agreement on stablecoin regulation. This development signals progress toward establishing a clearer and more defined regulatory framework for stablecoins in the United States.
title: Circle Shares Jump 20% on Lawmakers' Stablecoin Deal Progress

details: KelpDAO has announced its decision to migrate its rsETH token to Chainlink's CCIP (Cross-Chain Interoperability Protocol) infrastructure. This move comes after a reported $300 million exploit and a dispute regarding claims made by LayerZero. This event underscores the ongoing security challenges within decentralized finance (DeFi) and highlights the critical need for robust and secure cross-chain solutions.
title: KelpDAO Migrates to Chainlink CCIP After LayerZero Exploit Dispute
